title: [Minor Visual Bug] Automation Location - Lat & Long not correctly displayed
symptom: When configuring an automation based on location, the field is not wide enough to display the number with the default 6 decimal places. The first 1-2 digits of the integer value are obscured behind the [-] sign, and the last 1-2 digits of the decimal value are obscured behind the [+] sign.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit referenced in the thread, which likely changed the precision to 5 decimals and the +/- step to 1.1m, but the exact changes are not described in the thread.
evidence_quote: When I looked at the code, I found it easy enough to change the precision to only 5 decimals and the +/- step to 1.1m instead of 0.11m.
